#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const double EPSILON = 1e-8;

double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
    return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
}

struct Point {
    double x, y;

    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}

    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return fabs(x - other.x) <= EPSILON && fabs(y - other.y) <= EPSILON;
    }

    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        return fastHypot(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
};

struct Line {
    double a, b, c;

    Line() : a(0), b(0), c(0) {}
    Line(const Point& p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }
    Line(double a, double b, double c) {
        double h = fastHypot(a, b);
        this->a = a / h;
        this->b = b / h;
        this->c = c / h;
    }

    bool parallel(const Line& other) const {
        return fabs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < EPSILON;
    }

    Point intersect(const Line& other) const {
        if (parallel(other)) return Point(NAN, NAN);
        double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        double x = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / det;
        double y = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det;
        return Point(x, y);
    }

    Line perpendicular(const Point& point) const {
        return Line(-b, a, b * point.x - a * point.y);
    }

    double value(const Point& point) const {
        return a * point.x + b * point.y + c;
    }

    double distance(const Point& center) const {
        return fabs(value(center));
    }

    vector<Point> intersect(const class Circle& circle) const;
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;

    Circle(const Point& center, double radius) : center(center), radius(radius) {}

    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double d = center.distance(other.center);
        if (d < EPSILON) return {};
        Line line(2 * (other.center.x - center.x),
                  2 * (other.center.y - center.y),
                  other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius +
                  center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                  center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y);
        return line.intersect(*this);
    }
};

vector<Point> Line::intersect(const Circle& circle) const {
    double dist = distance(circle.center);
    if (dist > circle.radius + EPSILON) return {};
    Point intersection = intersect(perpendicular(circle.center));
    if (isnan(intersection.x)) return {};
    if (fabs(dist - circle.radius) < EPSILON) return {intersection};
    double shift = sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
    return {Point(intersection.x + shift * b, intersection.y - shift * a),
            Point(intersection.x - shift * b, intersection.y + shift * a)};
}

// Union-Find with path compression and union by rank
class IndependentSetSystem {
public:
    vector<int> parent;
    vector<int> rank;
    int setCount;

    IndependentSetSystem(int size) {
        parent.resize(size);
        rank.resize(size, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) parent[i] = i;
        setCount = size;
    }

    bool join(int first, int second) {
        first = get(first);
        second = get(second);
        if (first == second) return false;
        if (rank[first] < rank[second]) swap(first, second);
        else if (rank[first] == rank[second]) rank[first]++;
        parent[second] = first;
        setCount--;
        return true;
    }

    int get(int index) {
        int start = index;
        while (parent[index] != index) {
            index = parent[index];
        }
        while (start != index) {
            int next = parent[start];
            parent[start] = index;
            start = next;
        }
        return index;
    }

    int getSetCount() const {
        return setCount;
    }
};

// Fast input reader
class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() : stream(&cin) {
    }

    int readInt() {
        int c;
        do {
            c = stream->get();
        } while (isspace(c));
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = stream->get();
        }
        int res = 0;
        while (c != EOF && !isspace(c)) {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                // InputMismatchException equivalent: just exit
                exit(1);
            }
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = stream->get();
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    void readIntArrays(vector<int>& x, vector<int>& y, vector<int>& r) {
        int n = x.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            x[i] = readInt();
            y[i] = readInt();
            r[i] = readInt();
        }
    }

private:
    istream* stream;
};

// Print integer to stdout
class OutputWriter {
public:
    void printLine(int value) {
        cout << value << '\n';
    }
};

// Count number of false in boolean array
int countFalse(const vector<bool>& arr) {
    int cnt = 0;
    for (bool v : arr) if (!v) cnt++;
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    InputReader in;
    OutputWriter out;

    int n = in.readInt();
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    in.readIntArrays(x, y, r);

    vector<Circle> circles;
    circles.reserve(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        circles.emplace_back(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }

    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            vector<Point> inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (!inter.empty()) {
                points.insert(points.end(), inter.begin(), inter.end());
            }
        }
    }

    int m = points.size();
    vector<bool> bad(m, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    int nVertices = countFalse(bad);
    int nEdges = 0;
    IndependentSetSystem dsu(m);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int current = 0;
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            if (!bad[j] && fabs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - circles[i].radius) < EPSILON) {
                current++;
                onThis.push_back(j);
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); ++j) {
            dsu.join(onThis[j], onThis[0]);
        }
        nEdges += max(current, 1);
    }

    int nComponents = dsu.getSetCount() - countTrue(bad); // we need count of true, but we compute countFalse, need countTrue = m - nVertices
    // Actually: nComponents = setCount - countTrue(bad) because setCount includes isolated points that are bad? Wait, Java code: int nComponents = setSystem.getSetCount() - ArrayUtils.count(bad, true);
    // Since bad true points are ignored? But in setSystem, we still have entries for bad points? Actually setSystem size is points.size() which includes bad points.
    // The countTrue(bad) is number of bad points (duplicates). Those are not considered as vertices? Actually in Java, countTrue(bad) is subtracted.
    // So we need countTrue.
    int countTrue = 0;
    for (bool b : bad) if (b) countTrue++;
    int nComponents = dsu.getSetCount() - countTrue;

    out.printLine(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents);

    return 0;
}
